panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (a, b, c, d). a: Low-power H&E of NXG skin biopsy showing diffuse dermal to subcutis mononuclear / foamy histiocytic infiltration, consistent with NXG in NXG case report. b: H&E shows palisaded granuloma with necrobiosis, classic NXG histology supported by in-text palisaded granulomas surrounding large necrobiotic areas. c: High-power H&E shows xanthoma / foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells, plus visible wreath-like Touton cell, diagnostic for NXG. d: High-power H&E shows cholesterol clefts in center of necrobiotic area, classic NXG feature confirmed by in-text mention.

in_text_mentions: When the patient presented to the dermatology clinic, physical examination was notable for yellow-brown papules and plaques on the medial upper eyelids and infraorbital region, as well as scattered yellow-brown flat-topped papules on his trunk and extremities. On his right knee, a large ulceration was noted within a yellow-brown plaque, as shown in Fig 1. There was no evidence of eye inflammation or macroglossia.Fig 1Diffuse yellow-brown depressed plaques and three ulcerations.
